title: Anjām, or Taṣavvuf u Ḥurūf ('Conclusion'; 'Sufism and Lettrism')

date.basis: MK: 'completed on' this date, which is also the date of the Majlis 10196 copy (ff. 158a-60a); the folio lies in the chronological first half that MK says may record transcription (pp.78-79); not asterisked. Treated as a copying date; composition may be earlier.

manuscript: 9 copies listed; earliest dated: MS Majlis 10196 ff. 158a-60a (17 Dhū l-Qaʿda 828/30 Sept 1425); then MS 5423 (842/1439), MS 10004 (Yazd 903-4/1497-98), MS 1825 (Abarquh 851/1447), MS 9263/6, MS 3035/14, MS 326/6, MS 7136/5, MS Add. 16839 (BL).
summary: A comparison of Sufism with the science of letters, in an introduction and two sections, with an epilogue of three accounts in support of lettrism; section two refers the reader to the K. al-Mafāḥiṣ.
